description: 35 everyday adjectives, mostly in opposite pairs.

description: Body parts, "it hurts", the kupat cholim, sick notes, the gym.

title: Weather & Outdoors
description: Heat, humidity, rain, seasons, the beach and trips out of town.

title: Work & Study
description: Office, meetings, salary, hi-tech, deadlines, ulpan and exams.

title: Clothes & Colors
description: What you wear and the colors to describe it.

description: WhatsApp, chargers, voice notes, "send me your location", googling and texting.

title: Free Time
description: Movies, shows, matkot, BBQs, hanging out and having a good time.

description: Sentences written for the course lessons.
